mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing bupropion plasma concentrations and potentially decreasing efficacy; bupropion may lower seizure threshold opposing eslicarbazepine's anticonvulsant effect.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy and increased seizure risk; consider bupropion dose adjustment or alternative antidepressant with lower seizure risk.
